page.layout: One printed bookplate label, centred on the board: five lines of text, a round seal with its legend, and a final line below. No other printed text on the page.
page.notes: The page is the front board or pastedown of a binding, not a text page. The bookplate's round seal has a cross and rays at its centre. Its legend is set in a decorative letter, so the lower words are read with a [?]. The handwritten marks at the top left and centre (pencil or ink, one looking like "Longe" with a number) and the marks on the board are handwriting or stains, so they are not transcribed. The parchment-like surface, stains and the binding damage at the edges are not printed text.
